# iHoogi — Marketing Site (main)

> Official public marketing site. Fetch THESE URLs — not ihoogi.com (app).

- **Primary (new):** https://www.ihoogi.co.il/
- **Parallel (existing):** https://ai-4biz.github.io/ihoogi-marketing-site/
- **Version check:** https://www.ihoogi.co.il/version.json
- **Version check (github.io):** https://ai-4biz.github.io/ihoogi-marketing-site/version.json

Both URLs serve the same marketing site. The custom domain is an addition, not a replacement.

## How to verify you have the NEW site

Open either URL (no query params). The page MUST contain:
- H1 (Hebrew): "נכנסו פניות. למי כדאי לחזור קודם?"
- Founder section: "למה הקימתי את iHoogi"

If you see "האם מכל הפניות שנכנסות" or "מערכת שאלונים חכמה" — wrong site or stale browser cache.

- [Home (github.io)](https://ai-4biz.github.io/ihoogi-marketing-site/)
